_doc: StS1 base-game cards used by vanilla packs -> StS2 card class (MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Models.Cards). A string maps to the StS2 card of the same role (usually the same card, sometimes renamed); an object is a substitute for a card StS2 doesn't have, with the reason. gen_cards.py --pack-defs reads this; cards not listed keep their pack disabled. Checked against the card pools of the reference sts2.dll.

DoubleTap.note: StS2 has no Double Tap; One-Two Punch (rare skill) plays your next Attack an extra time

Choke.note: StS2's version of Choke (uncommon attack; the enemy loses HP whenever you play a card this turn)

SneakyStrike.note: StS2 has no Sneaky Strike; Flick-Flack is the common discard-synergy (Sly) attack

DoomAndGloom.note: StS2 has no Doom and Gloom; Null (uncommon attack) also deals damage and channels Dark

Recursion.note: StS2 has no Recursion; Darkness (uncommon skill) is the closest orb-manipulation skill: channel Dark and trigger Dark passives
